spans.s:
धौमक धौमक, अस्, m. (fr. धूम), N. of
a district.

धौमतायनक, अस्, m. a patronymic from
Dhaumatāyana.
धौमायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Dhūma.

धौम्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Dhūma;
N. of an ancient Ṛṣi; a son of Vyāghra-pāda;
a younger brother of Devala and family priest of the
Pāṇḍavas; a pupil of Vālmīki.
—धौम्य-शिक्षा,
f. ‘the science of Dhaumya,’ N. of a chapter of the
Purāṇa-sarva-sva.

धौम्र, अस्, m., N. of an ancient Ṛṣi; N. of
a class of demons; (अम्), n. grey (the colour), grey-
ness; a place for building prepared in a peculiar
way; [cf. धूम.]

धौम्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Dhūmra;
[cf. धूम्रायण.]
